extensionDescription.message: Translate web pages on your own device. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

popupModeGroup.description: Accessible name for the display mode buttons

popupChecking.description: Button label while the popup is still asking about the page

popupShowOriginal.description: Main button once the page is translated

popupTranslating.description: Main button while a page is being translated

popupChooseLanguage.description: Main button when the page language is unknown

popupAlreadyTarget.description: Main button when the page is already in the target language

popupNoModel.description: Main button when no model exists for the pair

popupDownloadAndTranslate.description: Main button, $1 is a size such as 24 MB

popupBlockedButton.description: Main button when a site rule or a known language rules the page out

popupUnsupportedButton.description: Main button on a machine whose processor cannot run the engine

popupGrantButton.description: Button that asks for the model hosts

popupGrantFirst.description: Main button while the model hosts are not allowed

popupGrantExplanation.message: Glossa needs permission to reach Mozilla's model hosts before it can download a language.
popupGrantExplanation.description: Why the button above is there

popupGrantAllowed.message: Model hosts allowed. Downloads can run now.
popupGrantAllowed.description: Shown after the permission is granted

popupGrantRefused.message: Without that permission Glossa cannot download a language model.
popupGrantRefused.description: Shown when the permission request is declined

popupDetectAutomatically.description: First entry of the page-language list

popupInvite.message: Click Translate to read this page in your language.
popupInvite.description: Status line before anything has happened

popupUnsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be translated (browser or extension page).
popupUnsupportedPage.description: Status line on a page no extension may touch

popupUnsupportedCpu.message: This computer's processor lacks the SIMD instructions the engine needs, so Glossa cannot translate here.
popupUnsupportedCpu.description: Status line on a machine whose processor cannot run the engine

popupModelReady.message: Model ready. Translation runs on this device.
popupModelReady.description: Status line when the model for the chosen pair is on disk

popupModelSize.description: Status line, $1 is a language name and $2 a size

popupPivot.message: Translates through English (two models, $1 on disk).
popupPivot.description: Status line for a pair that goes through English, $1 is a size

popupNoRoute.message: No on-device model can translate $1 to $2 yet.
popupNoRoute.description: Status line, $1 and $2 are language names

popupCatalogUnavailable.description: Status line, $1 is the underlying error

popupTranslatedBlocks.description: Status line, $1 is a number of blocks

popupRestored.description: Status line after showing the original

popupRemembered.message: Using $1, the language you chose for this site.
popupRemembered.description: Status line, $1 is a language name the user picked for this site

popupNoTab.description: Status line when the popup cannot find a tab to act on

popupVerifying.description: Progress line, $1 is a file name

popupLoadingEngine.description: Progress line, $1 is a language pair

popupDownloadFailed.description: Progress line when a download fails with no message

popupPrivacyLine.message: Runs on this device. No page text leaves your browser.

selectionOffer.description: Button next to a selection, $1 is a language code

selectionOfferTitle.message: Translate the selected text with Glossa
selectionOfferTitle.description: Tooltip of the button next to a selection

popoverClose.description: Close button of the translation popover

popoverLabel.description: Accessible name of the translation popover

popoverTranslating.description: Popover text while the engine works

popoverNoLanguage.message: Could not detect the language of the selection.

popoverAlready.description: Popover text, $1 is a language code

popoverNoAnswer.message: The translation engine did not answer.

pageNoLanguage.message: Could not detect the page language

pageAlreadyTarget.description: Error reported to the popup, $1 is a language code

pageEngineSilent.message: No answer from the translation engine

blockedBySiteRule.message: Glossa is turned off for $1. Change that on the options page.
blockedBySiteRule.description: Why a page is not offered, $1 is a host name

blockedByKnownLanguage.message: You read $1, so this page is left alone.
blockedByKnownLanguage.description: Why a page is not offered, $1 is a language name

optionsHover.message: Show the original text on hover when replacing

optionsSelectionPopup.message: Offer a translation when text is selected (off by default, uses the context menu otherwise)

optionsKnownHint.message: Pages in these languages are never offered for translation.

optionsRuleWaiting.description: Site rule that has no permission yet

optionsRuleWaitingTitle.message: Glossa has no permission to read $1, so this rule does nothing. Remove it and add it again to be asked.
optionsRuleWaitingTitle.description: Tooltip on the row above, $1 is a host name

optionsModelsHint.message: Each model is downloaded once from Mozilla's catalog, checked against its published hash, and kept on this device. Nothing else is ever sent or received.

optionsExperimental.message: Offer Mozilla's prerelease models (Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bosnian, Norwegian, Nynorsk). Quality is untested and Firefox ships them to its nightly channel only.

optionsSourceHint.message: Model files come from Mozilla's attachment CDN, or from Mozilla's model bucket when the CDN refuses this browser.
optionsSourceHint.description: Explains where model files come from

optionsPrivacyEngine.message: Translation runs inside your browser using the Bergamot engine that Firefox uses. Page text never leaves this device.

optionsPrivacyPermission.message: The extension has no permission to read websites on its own. It only touches a page when you ask it to.

optionsPrivacyNetwork.message: Network access is limited to three Mozilla-operated locations, used only to fetch the model catalog and model files:
optionsPrivacyNetwork.description: Privacy bullet, followed by the list of hosts

optionsPrivacyHashes.message: Every file is checked against the hash Mozilla publishes before it is used.
optionsPrivacyHashes.description: Privacy bullet, after the host list

optionsPrivacyTelemetry.message: No account, no telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting.

optionsNoAccessToast.message: Without access to $1, that rule cannot translate on its own

optionsBadHostToast.message: $1 is not a host Glossa can ask for
optionsBadHostToast.description: Toast, $1 is what the user typed

optionsSourceCdn.message: Next download will try Mozilla's CDN first
optionsSourceCdn.description: Toast, which source the next download uses

optionsSourceBucket.message: Next download will try Mozilla's bucket first
optionsSourceBucket.description: Toast, which source the next download uses

optionsSelectKnownLanguage.description: Accessible name of the languages-you-read select

optionsSelectRuleKind.message: What to do on this site
optionsSelectRuleKind.description: Accessible name of the rule select

optionsSelectInstallFrom.description: Accessible name of the from-language select

optionsSelectInstallTo.description: Accessible name of the to-language select

optionsCatalogLine.message: Catalog: $1 source and $2 target languages, refreshed $3. Downloads come from $4.

optionsModelsEmptyLine.message: No models downloaded yet. The first translation downloads what it needs.

fieldEmpty.message: There is nothing in that field to translate

fieldNotFound.message: Right-click inside the field you want translated

fieldTranslated.message: Field translated. Undo with Ctrl+Z if that was not what you wanted.

optionsEngineLabel.description: Options: label of the engine choice

optionsEngineHint.message: Both run on this device. Chrome's translator gets its language packs from Google through Chrome's own updater and needs 22 GB of free disk. While it is selected, translating a page sends nothing to Mozilla's servers.
optionsEngineHint.description: Options: what the Chrome engine choice means

popupChromeDownloading.description: Popup progress; $1 is a percentage number

popupChromePackNeeded.message: Chrome downloads the $1 language pack the first time.
popupChromePackNeeded.description: Popup status; $1 is a language pair such as Spanish → English

popupChromeReady.message: Chrome's language pack is ready. Translation runs on this device.

popupChromeNoPair.message: Chrome's built-in translator has no pack for $1 to $2.
popupChromeNoPair.description: Popup status; $1 and $2 are language names

pageChromeNeedsDownload.message: Chrome needs its language pack first. Open Glossa's popup on this page and click the button to download it.

pageChromeUnavailable.message: Chrome's built-in translator is not available in this browser. Switch the engine back to Bergamot in Glossa's settings.
